🎬 You Are So Not Invited to My Bat Mitzvah (2023)

You Are So Not Invited to My Bat Mitzvah follows Stacy Friedman, a teenage girl who dreams of having the perfect bat mitzvah celebration alongside her best friend, Lydia. With exciting party plans, school crushes, and big expectations, Stacy believes everything is falling into place until an unexpected romantic misunderstanding threatens their friendship. When jealousy, embarrassment, and teenage drama begin to take over, the two friends find themselves caught in a hilarious rivalry that could ruin their special celebrations. As Stacy navigates family expectations, growing up, and the challenges of friendship, she discovers that becoming more mature means learning to forgive and appreciate the people who truly care about her. Starring Sunny Sandler, Samantha Lorraine, and Adam Sandler, the film combines heartfelt moments with relatable coming-of-age comedy.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Coming-of-Age

⭐ IMDb: 6.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 43m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Sammi Cohen

✍️ Writer: Alison Peck

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: You Are So Not Invited to My Bat Mitzvah is a 2023 American coming-of-age comedy-drama film directed by Sammi Cohen, written by Alison Peck, and produced by Adam Sandler, Tim Herlihy, Leslie Morgenstein, and Elysa Koplovitz Dutton. Based on the 2005 young adult novel of the same name, the film stars Sandler and his wife, Jackie Sandler, as well as their daughters, Sadie and Sunny Sandler. It also stars Samantha Lorraine, Idina Menzel, Dylan Hoffman, Sarah Sherman, Dan Bulla, Ido Mosseri, Jackie Hoffman, and Luis Guzmán. It tells the story of two best friends whose bat mitzvah plans go awry as they fight for the attention of the same popular boy. Produced by Happy Madison Productions and Allo
